job.title: Contentstack / Headless CMS Architects - 100% remote, ASAP, 6+ months

tailoring.headline: Headless CMS & Solution Architecture Specialist | SAP Commerce Cloud Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, RESTful and OCC APIs, micro-services, and data pipelines integrating PIM, ERP and MDM. Proven record in solution design, stakeholder management, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments and AI-assisted development. Strong techno-functional consulting experience in agile, international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Contentstack / Headless CMS Architect
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Wynwood Tech’s focus on cutting-edge digital experiences. With 5+ years building headless e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in API-first architecture, integration, and scalable cloud deployments that align perfectly with your Contentstack initiatives.

bullets.label: **Solution Architecture**
bullets.text: Designed end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud solutions, defining data models, APIs and integration points that delivered robust, scalable digital experiences for global enterprises.

bullets.label: **Headless API Development**
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, enabling seamless front-end consumption and third-party integrations across B2B/B2C channels.

bullets.label: **Enterprise Integration**
bullets.text: Built PIM-to-Commerce data pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, and resolved complex ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks with international technical teams.

bullets.label: **CI/CD & Cloud Deployment**
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD cycles on Jenkins, Docker and Kubernetes, delivering reliable releases on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Available for a conversation at your convenience.

tailoring.why_company: Wynwood Tech’s reputation for delivering innovative, composable digital experiences to leading US agencies aligns with my passion for headless architectures. Your focus on Contentstack and modern cloud-native solutions offers the perfect platform to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, drive seamless integrations, and contribute to high-impact projects for global clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my headless commerce and integration expertise to help Wynwood Tech build scalable, API-first digital experiences with Contentstack.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of headless architecture experience. I’m keen to discuss how I can contribute to Wynwood Tech’s Contentstack projects. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Contentstack / Headless CMS Architect
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Contentstack / Headless CMS Architect role. I bring 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, strong solution architecture skills, and a proven record in API-first integrations. I look forward to discussing how I can add value to Wynwood Tech.
